transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling completely emotionally numb for the past three weeks. I just can't seem to feel any happiness or joy, even when good things happen to me. My mind feels completely empty of any positive emotions.
Have you had a clear stressful event or major life change that started around the time these feelings began?

I'm not really sure, and I can't pinpoint a specific event or change that started all of this. I just know that these feelings of numbness and being constantly on edge have been going on for about three weeks now.
Have you been feeling down, numb, or unable to enjoy things for most days for more than two years, or is this a much newer problem?

No, this is a brand new problem for me. I have only been feeling this complete numbness and lack of joy for about three weeks now. Before this started, I didn't feel this way at all, so it is definitely not something I've been dealing with for years.
Over these past three weeks, have you also had other symptoms like poor sleep, changes in appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of self-harm?

No, I haven't really experienced any of those issues like poor sleep, appetite changes, or thoughts of self-harm. For me, it is really just this constant emotional numbness and feeling incredibly tense and alert all the time.
Has this numbness and tension been making it hard for you to work, study, or keep up with your usual daily activities?

Yes, it has been really hard to focus and just get through the day because of the constant numbness and tension. I'm definitely struggling to keep up with my normal daily activities and routine right now.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things most days, and is it hard to control that worry?
No, I wouldn't say I am worrying about a lot of different general things. It's more that I feel a constant state of tension and alertness, along with this complete emotional numbness.
Did these symptoms start within about three months of a stressful life event or major change, even if it did not seem clearly linked at first?
I'm really not sure, and I can't think of any specific stressful event or major change that happened right before this. All I know is that these feelings started quite suddenly about three weeks ago.
Do you often feel restless or keyed up, have muscle tension, or feel easily fatigued because of the tension?
I'm not really sure about having muscle tension or feeling easily fatigued. I do feel a constant sense of being keyed up and unable to relax, but I haven't noticed those other physical symptoms.
Over these past three weeks, have you felt sad, hopeless, or lost interest or pleasure in most things nearly every day?

Yes, for the past three weeks, I have felt a complete loss of pleasure and happiness. It is like a state of emotional numbness where my mind feels completely empty, and I cannot experience any joy or satisfaction even when good things happen.
Did these symptoms begin after a stressful life event or major change, even if you are not sure exactly when it started?
I'm really not sure about that. I can't think of any specific stressful event or major change that would have triggered this.
